notes.title: Update 1.6.0
notes.notes:
I am showing off my game at an independent games developer's conference, so I am updating the Steam version to be the latest version of the game to make it parity with mobile. Changes include:

[list]
[*]Added 10 levels, increasing the total level count from 170 to 180
[*]Tutorial has been expanded to 15 levels.
[*]Novice has been expanded to 40 levels.
[*]Bug fixes.
[*]Texture fixes.
[*]Levels rearranged based on perceived difficulty.
[/list]

notes.title: One Year Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
It's a bit hard to believe that it has been a year since I released my game out into the world. There has been a lot of learning to do; but for requirements to have each build iteration have a unique number, I would have easily lost count the number of times I have made changes.

But enough about me, this update is about the game itself. Just a few of the changes that I have been working on since the last update are:
[list]
[*]Added a cold opening that puts the player right into the game if it is their first time playing.
[*]Added a new difficulty called "Tutorial".
[*]Total level count increased to 170.
[*]Level modifications here and there.
[*]Various new ball types, including Sun.
[*]A new Progress screen that shows how close the player is to unlocking a ball.
[*]Bug fixes and optimizations.
[/list]

As per usual if you notice anything odd feel free to contact me and I will work to resolve it in a new build.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed loading quicksave with the cannonball giving a different ball altogether.
[*]Rearranged some voicelines because of the store being removed; they are now used elsewhere.
[/list]

[h2]Ultimate Pack![/h2]
[list]
[*]The store for the game has been removed.
[*]In its place is the Ultimate Pack, which you can buy as DLC off of Steam (at the time of releasing Update 1.0.6, the Ultimate Pack is not available, but it will be very soon).
[*]It gives you the eyeball playable ball, which is pretty cool.
[*]It also unlocks Freeplay mode.
[/list]

[h2]Freeplay Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*]Gives unlimited lives; you can keep going until you win!
[*]Balls obtained from beating a difficulty can be obtained from Freeplay mode, balls that require a specific mode such as Score or Survival cannot.
[*]Freeplay results are not eligible for high scores or leaderboards.
[*]Freeplay earns ballcoin at 1/20th the rate of normal modes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug "Play for Score" button would revert to lowercase if switching from Full font.
[/list]
[h2]Pricing Changes[/h2]
[h3]To give you the boost to make it to the next level![/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed 1 ball purchase option because Steam would not allow purchases below a dollar.
[*][b]Prices have permanently slashed by 40% across the board.[/b] For instance, 6 lives are now $2.99 instead of $4.99.
[*][i][b]55 lives is reduced even further to $19.99[/b][/i], a permanent decrease of 50%, and approximately 36 cents for each increase of your maximum life counter.
[*]To keep the Starter Pack better in line with these price cuts, it now gives 7 lives and the Cannonball. This even applies retroactively to those who have bought the Starter Pack already!
[*]Changed script order so that a player will receive the seven increased starting lives from the Starter Pack even if he or she fails or refuses to claim the Cannonball.
[/list]
